File:U S Marines with 3-12 Conduct Comba.desc: U.S. Marine Corps Lance Cpl. Pablo Monteverde, an ammunition technician, with 1st Battalion, 11th Marines, currently forward deployed with 3rd Battalion, 12th Marine Regiment, conducts night-time rocket pod transfer training at Rodriguez Live Fire Complex, Republic of Korea, March 23, 2026. KMEP is a semi-annual exercise that provides opportunities for ROK Marine Corps and U.S. Marine Corps units to train together, improving their combined capabilities to deter threats and maintain peace on the Korean Peninsula. Monteverde is a native of Arizona. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Cpl. Logan Smith)
